productBoundary: general educational recovery/warm-up guidance only; non-diagnostic

reviewStatuses.draft: created, not yet reviewed; must NOT be published
reviewStatuses.in-review: under professional review; must NOT be published
reviewStatuses.approved: reviewed and approved; the only status permitted in a release build
reviewStatuses.rejected: reviewed and rejected; must NOT be published
reviewStatuses.blocked: license, source, or rights missing, or content unsafe; must NOT be published

buildGate.rule: Any exercise whose reviewStatus is not in publishableReviewStatuses, or that lacks any requiredExerciseFields, must fail content validation and be excluded from the release build.
buildGate.currentStatus: defined; not yet wired (no app/build until S05)

unsafeContent.rule: Refuse or redirect; never produce. Do not use disclaimers to excuse unreliable content.
categories: interpreting soreness as a specific injury
facilitating self-harm, substance misuse, or unsafe exertion

refusal.style: brief and non-judgmental; state the boundary; redirect to general guidance or professional assessment
templates: RecoverMate gives general recovery guidance only and cannot diagnose or treat. If symptoms are severe or persist, please seek qualified assessment.
I cannot recommend treatments or dosages. Please consult a qualified professional.

redFlags.description: Stop signals shown on every exercise detail; users should stop and seek qualified assessment.
items: inability to move or bear weight
symptoms that persist or affect performance

escalation.onRedFlag: display the stop-signal prompt prominently; do not diagnose; recommend stopping and seeking qualified professional assessment
escalation.sourceToAdapt: AAOS public warning-sign guidance (a reference to consult, not an endorsement of RecoverMate)
escalation.doNot: do not auto-interpret soreness as a specific injury; do not promise outcomes

pageLevelSafetyPrompt.rule: Every exercise detail MUST show the red-flag/stop-signal prompt, and it must not be obscured by visuals.
requirements: present in the DOM before media/animation
not hidden behind overlays, particles, or autoplay media
remains visible and readable with prefers-reduced-motion enabled
reachable and operable by keyboard and screen readers

endorsements.rule: Do not fabricate organizational endorsements (e.g., ACSM, AAOS). Public references are sources to consult, not endorsements of RecoverMate.

dataMinimization: collect no health history, diagnoses, or production body-part selections; research data is anonymized and offline
